tests.title: Dependency dan lisensi
tests.expected: Lockfile, asset provenance, lisensi dan advisory relevan diperiksa; unresolved risk dengan dampak nyata memblokir GO
observations: Lockfile, local assets/licenses and runtime dependency review.

tests.title: Paket rilis
tests.expected: Source/dist/docs/evidence lengkap, SHA-256 benar, ZIP CRC lulus, file guide menunjuk lokasi yang benar
observations: Distribution preflight and safe, self-verifying whole-payload packaging command. Final ZIP itself is accepted only after all member CRCs and hashes pass this command.
limitations: The final archive cannot contain its own final digest; the packing receipt reports it externally.

tests.title: Klaim hasil
tests.expected: RELEASE_STATUS cocok evidence; tidak mengklaim server aktif, jumlah unik, real-device pass atau official curriculum tanpa bukti
observations: Six status fields separate executable product, bank, contract, live LMS, pilot and deployment.
